case_number: 2025 INSC 291; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (CRL.) NO.354 OF 2019) AND CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (CRL.) NO.2812 OF 2019)
summary: Challenge to FIR and denial of anticipatory bail; allegations under IPC s.409, s.219, s.114; order restoring land in appeal after 7-year delay; quasi-judicial function vs criminal misconduct; no entrustment of property negates s.409; erroneous exercise of power not criminal; mala fide prosecution alleged due to political vendetta; HC refused bail citing pattern of misconduct and need for custodial interrogation; earlier quashing petition dismissed; precedent of upheld order in 2012; retired IAS officer; investigation pattern viewed as harassment; issues of abuse of process and protection of public officials.
final_judgment: Details of final disposition not specified in provided text.
